name: ClearWorthPlanner
summary: A local-first Windows finance workspace with dashboards, budgets, Planning Studio, guided Secure Sync and editable bank import review. Version 1.3.1 is available as an unsigned installer; bank linking has limited trial availability.

name: Tandem
summary: Personal and shared goals with editable planning steps, dated actions, calendar export, XP, connected circles, and monthly reflections. Initial releases prioritize Windows and Android.

name: Study Companions
summary: Four self-contained, offline HTML study workspaces for Esri professional certification preparation, with flashcards, practice exams, and documentation links.
